amends: protocol.t1.v1.json t1d_dose_design section (sha256 f56c8d34f55a4159232806577afac4035e7501d966107519669bbf072981bed8); composes with protocol.t1.v1.1.json (t1c amendment, sha256 37012927f531ba31c9dd04f3ebc24b7ec4c816366148d68b78bc95f6927a4543)
written_before: any T1d training run. No dose-point checkpoint exists at freeze time.
positioning: The estimand is the capability-transport response T_gh = dJ_g/d rho_h at rho=0 over baseline competence regions g in {E,M,H} (pi0 difficulty strata; no semantic-skill claim), plus curvature H_g within w<=3. The paper's primary results are (1) predictiveness, (2) decision validity, (3) correct rejection, (4) interaction/compute efficiency — NOT headline success rate.

matched_training_rule.steps: Every dose point, including the zero-dose optimizer-only point and all held-out validation points, trains for the SAME number of gradient steps S_star with identical batch size, learning-rate schedule, optimizer hyperparameters, and initialization (frozen Base200 600.ckpt).
matched_training_rule.s_star_rule: S_star = round(0.15 * S_base200) where S_base200 is the gradient-step count of the Base200 training run, read from its training log; the resolved integer and the full launch config are written to t1d_launch_config.json + sha256 BEFORE the first dose-point run.
matched_training_rule.dose_semantics: rho_h is the sampling proportion of source h in the training mixture; the remainder of every batch is the frozen Base200 expert set (rehearsal). Dose is implemented by sampling weights at fixed S_star, never by changing dataset size or step count, so T_gh is not confounded with training amount.
matched_training_rule.per_sample_overuse_bound: w = rho/q <= 3 enforced per source (unchanged invariant).

dose_points.training_design_9: unchanged from v1: 1 zero-dose optimizer-only, 4 single-source vertices (D_E, D_M, D_H, D_Q), 3 two-source mixes, 1 double center point. Center point doubles as the Difficulty-balanced SFT baseline.

held_out_validation_4.points: the 3 held-out mix points of v1, PLUS rho_nat frozen here as the 4th

rho_nat.definition: the natural success-only self-training mixture: group shares of pi0 successes in the frozen T1b census (place_container_plate: 1215 easy / 115 medium / 15 hard of 1345 successes)
rho_nat.roles: (a) Success-only SFT baseline (identical to Uniform self-training under success-only BC), (b) held-out prediction target far from the D-optimal support, (c) empirical instance of the coverage-collapse law (theory target 1).

dose_points.total_small_runs: 13 points x 4 training seeds = 52 runs per task passing the source-feasibility gate (currently: place_container_plate only).

gate_1_predictiveness.estimator: Delta_hat_g(rho) = T_hat_g. rho + rho^T H_hat_g rho fit on the 9 training points only
criteria: Spearman(Delta_hat_g, Delta_g_observed) over the 4 held-out points x 3 regions >= 0.6 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
safe/unsafe classification: a point is 'safe' iff min{Delta_H-0.05, Delta_E+0.05, Delta_M+0.05} > 0; predicted-vs-observed agreement >= 3/4 held-out points
gate_1_predictiveness.role: primary gate of the paper; failure here fails T2 freeze.

gate_2_decision_validity.procedure: solve max_rho min_{T in U_T} [T rho]_H s.t. min_{T in U_T}[T rho]_E >= -0.05, min_{T in U_T}[T rho]_M >= -0.05, c^T rho <= B, w <= 3; U_T from the hierarchical posterior of the dose-point fits; then run rho_star as a 5th validation training (4 seeds)
gate_2_decision_validity.criteria: Gamma = min{Delta_H - 0.05, Delta_E + 0.05, Delta_M + 0.05} one-sided 95% lower confidence bound > 0 at rho_star; rho_star beats rho_nat on hard-group delta

required_output_schema.binding_constraints: list of the constraints active at the infeasibility certificate
required_output_schema.missing_source: one or more of D_M | D_H_supported | D_Q
required_output_schema.q_star_lower_bound: minimum additional expert trajectories (with target region) implied by the dual variables, or 'not_computable' with reason
required_output_schema.evidence: environment_validity, group_sizes, U_h, n_eff per source

gate_3_correct_rejection.criteria: the pipeline, run end-to-end on dump_bin inputs, emits this certificate and NEVER emits a mixture recommendation; abstention is the correct output, scored as such.

gate_4_efficiency_ledger.rule: every stage appends to efficiency_ledger.jsonl: {stage, task, episodes_simulated, successful_trajectories_stored, expert_demos_used, training_runs, gradient_steps, gpu_hours, wall_clock}. Comparison target: total cost of tomography+rho_star vs the counterfactual grid of full fine-tunes it replaces, and literature-reported interaction counts for RL fine-tuning (DPPO-class).
gate_4_efficiency_ledger.criteria: descriptive (no pass/fail), but MUST be reported; omission fails T2 freeze.

rl_baseline_policy: No RL fine-tuning enters the T1 critical path. T1 compares against Success-only SFT (rho_nat), Difficulty-balanced SFT (center point), and zero-dose, all inside the matched-steps design. Tomography-guided RL vs uniform RL is a post-T3 optional extension on place_container_plate only, and its absence in T1 is not a gate failure.
dump_bin_deliverable: For dump_bin_bigbin the T1d deliverable is the gate_3 certificate plus the support-degeneracy analysis (P(A=1)=46.7%, medium U=3, supported-hard U=8); no dose-point training is run on it under this revision.
